text: Coffee with Anya and Ravi. Anya's driving test is next Tuesday, third attempt, and she's properly nervous about the roundabouts. Ravi's gone vegan since the summer. Text Anya good luck Monday night. Also Ravi's birthday is next month and he keeps going on about a cookbook by some vegan chef, could be the one.

Long catch-up with Aisha after book club. She's 20 weeks pregnant, due March 9, and the morning sickness has finally eased off. Her husband Owen still can't stand the smell of coffee in the house, so she's switched to rooibos. Owen's brother Eli is getting married in Cork on April 11 and she's dreading the flight that late on. Ask her after the next scan how things look.
Wiremu passed his bar exam!! Results came out Thursday. His partner Alana is throwing him a dinner on Saturday. Need to get him a card before then.

Nia says the christening is off, the vicar double-booked. They're doing a small lunch at her mum's instead on October 31. Nia's little one, Esther, is six months now and already eating mashed avocado.
Dong is coeliac, don't forget. He's coming Friday with Eli. Eli doesn't drink, likes ginger beer.
Quick call with Gabriel. His daughter Mia has her grade 5 piano exam on November 12 and won't practise. He's more stressed than she is.
Note to self: pick up oat milk, the decaf beans and printer ink tomorrow.

Aoife's SATs scores came back really high, she's thinking about applying to Trinity. Her dad Gintaras wants her to stay closer to home. Ask her how the open day goes on the 14th. She's also sitting her grade 7 flute in the spring and wants to be a vet eventually. Gintaras keeps bees, of all things, and brought me a jar of honey.
Imani and Irina are expecting twins! Due around 5/14. They've been trying for ages. Must send flowers this week.
Rana mentioned she's lactose intolerant but cheats for proper gelato. Also hates coriander.

Lunch with Petra and Divya. Divya's sister Meera has her nursing finals in a fortnight and she's barely sleeping. Petra's off to Lisbon June 3rd for a long weekend. I'm driving Petra to the airport. Divya's gone pescatarian and swears by it. Meera loves those sour cola bottles, so maybe a care package for revision week would cheer her up.
Remember Carmen's partner Jorge is allergic to shellfish, nearly ended up in A&E last year. Book somewhere without a seafood menu for the anniversary dinner on the 22nd.

Bumped into Tendai at the school gate. Lwazi, his youngest, starts reception next September and they're already worrying about the catchment. Tendai's wife is on a strict keto thing and he's miserable about it, lol.

Kalani auditioned for the National Youth Theatre yesterday. Hears back in about three weeks. She was shaking before going in, her mum said. Check in with her next Friday. Her mum also said Kalani's gone off dairy completely and their dog Pepper keeps stealing her oat yoghurts off the counter, which is hilarious. Her dad is away on a rig until December.
Mila had the baby!! A boy, Theo, born Sunday morning at 7lb 2oz. Mila and Anan both exhausted but happy. Don't forget to drop round a lasagne, no mushrooms, Anan won't touch them.

Ayo's theory test was moved to Wednesday. He keeps failing the hazard perception part. Ayo also mentioned his mum's 60th is on the weekend of the 8th, she loves Baileys apparently. He reckons the whole family is going for a Sunday roast at the Plough. Thinking about chipping in with him on something nice for her, maybe a spa day.
Eilidh Murphy, aka Lee, rang about the reunion. She's gluten free now and only drinks prosecco. The reunion is Saturday the 19th at the Crown.

Aaliyah failed her driving test this morning on a minor mirror check. Gutted. She rebooked for December 4th. Should take her for a drive this weekend to practise. Her mum Rana said she was in tears in the car park and didn't want to talk to anyone. Rana's planning a cheer-up curry night on Friday, Aaliyah's favourite is paneer butter masala.
Owen and Aisha found out it's a girl at the 20-week scan on Monday. They're keeping the name secret. Owen is suddenly into baking and brought in banana bread.
Meera passed her finals!!! Message her congrats tonight.

Long chat with Esther on the phone. Her grandson Gabriel's christening is set for May 14, at St Mary's, and she's doing all the food herself. She's worried about the cost and how her knee will hold up. She asked if I could do the cake, which I've said yes to. Gabriel's mum is Divya. Divya's dad is flying in from Chennai the Tuesday before. Text Esther on Thursday to sort the cake flavours.
Note: Ravi's cat Biscuit had a tooth out last week, he's paranoid now about what she eats. Ravi himself is on a low FODMAP diet for the IBS.
Jorge does Dry January every year and also somehow Sober October. Fine with alcohol-free beer though.
Imani's mum has her hip op on Friday. Imani is going to stay with her for a week. Ring Imani on the weekend to see how her mum's doing.

Irina said her son Gintaras has his GCSE mocks starting Monday. He's revising nonstop and wound up. She's thinking of cancelling her trip to Vilnius. Remind me to send him some snacks, he loves those salt and vinegar Hula Hoops.
Dinner at Nia's. Wiremu was there too. Wiremu just got into the choir, first rehearsal next Wednesday. Nia's made her famous jollof and said she's trying to cut down on sugar.
Gym tomorrow 7am then dentist at 11.
Petra hinted she'd like a really good olive oil for her birthday. Something Greek. Her birthday is August 3rd.
Saw Alana at the farmers market. She's pregnant with number two! Due in early summer. Her husband Kalani wants a big family. She's off caffeine completely, which she says is killing her.
Aoife had her violin audition for the conservatoire on Tuesday. Thinks it went badly. Results in a week or so. I should message her Friday to see if she's heard anything.
Rana's brother Anan is taking his driving test tomorrow. Rana says he's cocky about it. Anan only eats halal, keep in mind for the barbecue on Sunday.
Catch up with Mia. She passed her GCSE maths resit! Her boyfriend Eli is vegetarian and she's trying to be one too. They're going to Edinburgh at the end of the month.
Called Dr Kumar's office to move my appointment to next Thursday at 3.
Dong and his wife Carmen celebrated their tenth anniversary on Saturday. They did a tasting menu, Dong said it was the best meal of his life. Carmen's mum is now ill again and they're worried.
Ayo told me his partner Lwazi is 12 weeks along! Scan was this morning. They're telling family at Lwazi's parents' this weekend. Lwazi craves pickled onions and nothing else.
Anya mentioned she's getting into fermentation, has a kombucha scoby named Gerald.
Owen's mother passed away on Monday. Funeral is a week on Friday. He sounded wrecked. Need to send a card and maybe drop off some food.
Divya's daughter Aaliyah starts uni in September, studying pharmacology at Leeds. Divya is quietly devastated about it. Aaliyah is a massive matcha fan, could be good for a going-away gift.
Eilidh's results day is Thursday. She's convinced she failed chemistry. Text her Thursday morning.
Gabriel and Petra are moving in together, viewing flats on the 9th and the 16th. Petra doesn't eat red meat, Gabriel eats nothing but red meat. Funny combo.
Tendai is training for his first marathon in April. Carb loading, strict about no alcohol. His brother Jorge is running it with him.
Wiremu's wife Imani had her baby shower cancelled because of the storm. They'll do something after the baby arrives instead. Due date is 6/2.
Esther nickname Essie told me her dog Rolo has a vet operation on Wednesday. She's dreading it.

Long voice note from Mila. Her baby Theo had his first jabs Tuesday and screamed the place down. Anan has gone back to work already, which she's finding tough. Her mum is coming to stay from Friday to help. Mila says she's living on toast and tea and would kill for a proper curry. I'm going round on Saturday with a takeaway from the Indian on the corner. Must check if she's still avoiding spicy food while breastfeeding.
Raised a glass for Irina's promotion. She starts as head of department after half term. Her husband Dong is cooking a celebration dinner on Saturday, all her favourites, she loves Georgian food.
Must buy candles and a card for Nia's birthday on the 27th.
Gintaras failed his driving test again yesterday, fourth time. Nervous wreck by the end, said the examiner was scary. Don't bring it up for a while. Maybe take him for coffee next week.
Bumped into Kalani's mum at Tesco. Kalani got a distinction in her grade 8 singing exam! She's now auditioning for music college on March 3rd.
Aisha had the baby early, Wednesday night, a little girl called Nur. Both in hospital still. Owen says they're doing ok. Visit when they're home, probably next weekend.
Carmen says Jorge is diabetic now, type 2, diagnosed last month. They've overhauled their whole kitchen. He misses doughnuts.

Coffee with Ravi, Aoife and Meera. Meera's pregnant!! Due in April. Aoife has her PhD viva next Monday and is terrified. Ravi just went teetotal and is weirdly evangelical about it. Text Aoife good luck Sunday night.
Big week ahead: interview Tuesday, Mum's on Wednesday, and Imani's leaving drinks Friday. Need to iron a shirt.
Alana mentioned Wiremu drinks only flat whites with oat milk and is allergic to tree nuts. Making sure for the picnic on May 20th.
Eli has his driving theory test on Monday, then the practical June 3rd. His mum Esther says he's surprisingly calm. Ask Eli how the theory goes next Tuesday.
Divya is doing Whole30, so no grains, dairy or sugar. She's also learning pottery on Thursday evenings.
Petra's sister Anya had a baby girl last night, Rosa, 8lb! Petra is off to see them tomorrow. Send a gift for the baby, something not pink, Anya hates pink.
Nothing major from the call with Ayo really, just complained about work and his landlord. He's thinking of moving out of London though.

Owen's christening plans for baby Nur: Sunday June 3rd at St Luke's, lunch after at the Fox. Aisha wants a vegetarian menu. I'm one of the godparents, eek. Should get a silver bracelet engraved before then.

Rana's son Lwazi has his 11+ exam this Saturday. Rana is a bag of nerves, Lwazi seems totally fine. Lwazi's into chess and climbing. They're celebrating afterwards with pizza whatever happens, and Lwazi's sister Nia is home from uni for it. Rana asked if I can do the school run Friday. Remember to text Rana Saturday afternoon to ask how it went.

Gabriel Rossi from the office said his wife Mia is expecting their first in the new year. He's planning paternity leave from January 6. She's off sushi and soft cheese, which she's sulking about. Remind me to organise a collection for Gabriel before Christmas.
